data: Do the lines representing the 5 sets of iterations all converge towards a similar value after 500 iterations?

The lines representing the 5 sets of iterations appear to converge towards a similar value after approximately 500 iterations. The caption specifies that the figure shows convergence of the log-likelihood for 5 sets of 1000 iterations. The lines are close together in the later stages of the graph, indicating convergence. Therefore, the answer is yes, the lines representing the 5 sets of iterations all converge towards a similar value after 500 iterations.
